# Static fighter manifest candidate v1

This is an exact engineering candidate contract under BRAWLCHAIN_SPEC §17, internally reviewed before oracle generation. It preserves canonical DNA v1. It does not settle new player policy, activate an official generator, create a fighter identity, validate work, assign ownership or birth, port fights, or approve marketplace pricing. Mike's D74 joint design review remains a later product-release gate.

The independent reference and corpus are preserved in `fightermanifest/testdata/`. The extracted handoff remains unchanged. The Go implementation in `fightermanifest` uses this contract and independently derived expectations; production outputs must never replace those fixtures.

## Version and input boundary

`manifest_version` is integer 1. `generator_id` is the exact ASCII string `slug-fighter-manifest-candidate-v1`. Unknown versions or generators fail; no latest-version fallback exists.

Generation takes one exactly 32-byte work seed in RPC display order. The text convenience parser accepts exactly 64 ASCII hexadecimal characters, upper or lower case, and normalizes output to lower case. It accepts zero; rejects shortened input, whitespace, prefixes, non-ASCII and non-hex characters; never reverses the decoded bytes. This is a preview seed, not evidence that work qualifies.

The output embeds the **entire existing DNA v1 record unchanged**, generated by the independently frozen `baseline/reference_dna.py`. The baseline oracle and original `dna_v1.json` are copied byte-for-byte and SHA256-pinned in `provenance.json`. Its distribution, streams, version and lifespan are not modified by this component. No names or appearance draws share its streams.

## Canonical tables and provenance

`tables_v1.json` is compact ASCII JSON in its committed field order, without a newline. It is immutable for this candidate version. The table hash is:

```
SHA256(ASCII "SLUG fighter manifest tables" || 00 || ASCII "v1" || 00 || tables_v1.json bytes)
```

The required lowercase hash is `72231fbe707cea9a65dd5b92f7b2719953795bceadbbf9e3b8e0b8f4aaef3f44`.

The 32 first names and 32 last names preserve the source order from `slug-sim-export/sim/fight_sim.py`. Surrounding ASCII whitespace is removed once when defining these frozen tables: source LAST index 17 `" Boone"` becomes `"Boone"`. Runtime generation does not trim, title-case, translate or customize names. Duplicate names are allowed. Full `display` is `first + U+0020 + last` exactly. No nickname is created.

Portrait colors, enum order, head-shape geometry, class builds and rarity rings originate in `sim/portraits.py`, with normalized lower snake_case identifiers. The unused tank-color table is omitted because the supplied renderer is shirtless. The copied geometry is provenance for a later renderer, not a promise that SVG arithmetic is already frozen. Source-file hashes and all transformations are recorded in `provenance.json`.

The new integer distributions, isolated streams and physical style predicates below are deliberate candidate tuning, **not byte-compatible Python RNG behavior**. Changing any table or algorithm later requires an explicit generator version, not a silent replacement of this hash.

## Independent random streams

For each ASCII label below, start a separate unsigned counter at zero. A draw hashes these exact bytes:

```
ASCII "SLUG fighter manifest" || 00 || ASCII "v1" || 00
|| ASCII label || 00 || seed[32] || counter[8 little-endian]
```

SHA256 is used only to expand the public seed. Interpret digest bytes 0 through 7 as one unsigned 64-bit big-endian value `r`; discard the rest; increment this label's counter. Counters must never wrap. Counter `2^64-1` can be encoded once; a later draw fails. Direct stream test vectors may inspect counters beyond those normally reached during generation.

Uniform sampling below positive bound `n` computes `t = 2^64 mod n`, rejects `r < t`, otherwise returns `r mod n`. Each field permits at most **256 draws**, including rejected draws. Exhaustion fails the entire manifest deterministically with no replacement value, label, seed, modulo fallback or partial output. All actual bounds below fit in uint64. This new bound applies to manifest streams; it does not retroactively change DNA v1.

Every listed label is independent and used for exactly one field. Optional scar placement has its own label; omitting its draw cannot change another field.

| Label | Uniform bound / interpretation |
| --- | --- |
| `name.first` | 32; first-name index |
| `name.last` | 32; last-name index |
| `physical.weight` | 329511; weighted integer allocation below |
| `physical.height_jitter` | 11; subtract 5, giving half-inch steps -5 through 5 |
| `physical.reach` | 7; subtract 2 inches |
| `physical.stance` | 4; ticket 0 is `southpaw`, all others `orthodox` |
| `portrait.skin` | 6; skin/shadow pair index |
| `portrait.hair_style` | 8; style index |
| `portrait.hair_color` | 6; color index |
| `portrait.facial_hair` | 5; index |
| `portrait.head_shape` | 4; index |
| `portrait.mouth` | 4; index |
| `portrait.brow` | 3; index |
| `portrait.background` | 8; color index |
| `portrait.scar_chance` | 100; below 35 yields a scar |
| `portrait.scar_site` | 2; 0 `left_brow`, 1 `right_cheek`, used only if a scar exists |
| `portrait.shoulder_jitter` | 13; subtract 6 |

Thus scars have exact 35% probability, with equal conditional placement, rather than the prototype's biased byte-modulo result. No portrait feature has gameplay power in this contract.

## Physical traits

Weight is an integer number of pounds from 128 through 268 inclusive, with a discrete triangular candidate distribution peaking at 178. For each integer `w`, define:

```
weight(w) = 91 * (w - 127)   when 128 <= w <= 178
            51 * (269 - w)  when 179 <= w <= 268
```

The sum is 329511. Draw one uniform rank below that sum. Visit weights in ascending pound order, subtracting each weight until rank is less than the current weight; select that pound value. No floating point or rejection by weight class occurs. Endpoints have nonzero probability. This approximates the original triangular range/mode while defining a portable integer distribution; it does not replicate `random.triangular`.

Let `j` be the sampled height-jitter step from -5 through 5. Compute height in tenths of an inch as `640 + (weight_lb - 128) + 5*j`. Round this positive integer divided by 10 to the nearest whole inch, **ties to even**, then clamp to [62,80]. This retains the source slope and range with eleven discrete half-inch jitter choices rather than continuous floating jitter.

Reach is `height_in + sampled_reach_offset`, where the offset is [-2,4]. Stance is defined in the stream table. Weight class uses these exact inclusive boundaries:

| Pounds | Enum |
| --- | --- |
| <=145 | `light` |
| 146–170 | `welter` |
| 171–195 | `middle` |
| 196–225 | `light_heavy` |
| >=226 | `heavy` |

The generator's actual weight remains within [128,268]. A helper classifying an independently supplied weight must not silently accept an invalid manifest weight.

## Derived style

Evaluate these predicates in order on **original DNA attributes** and generated physical traits. Return the first match; no random style draw is made. `reach_offset = reach_in - height_in`.

1. `slugger`: Power >=70, Chin >=65, Speed <60.
2. `outfighter`: Speed >=70, Skill >=65, reach_offset >=2.
3. `boxer_puncher`: Speed >=65, Power >=65.
4. `pressure`: Speed >=65, Stamina >=70, Skill >=55, reach_offset <=1.
5. Otherwise `boxer`.

The pressure Speed condition reflects D7's high-Speed/high-Stamina example; reach conditions make physical traits affect derived style. Source priority is preserved, including boxer-puncher taking precedence over pressure when both match. These thresholds are candidate tuning: measure and report the resulting style/class mix without claiming calibration of a fight engine. Style is a transparent label derived from public original values, not a sixth attribute. Aging, XP, training and form do not rewrite this static label in this version.

## Portrait DTO

All numeric portrait selections are zero-based indices into `tables_v1.json`; `scar` is `none`, `left_brow` or `right_cheek`, and `shoulder_jitter` is [-6,6]. `portrait_version` is exactly 1. Build and rarity-ring color are derived from the validated physical class and DNA rarity; callers cannot independently supply contradictory values. There is no arbitrary SVG, image URL, markup, face customization or nickname field.

The DTO fixes trait selection only. A bounded SVG renderer may follow once coordinate arithmetic, decimal formatting and visual review are explicit. No SVG or pixel digest is part of this candidate corpus.

## Exact manifest JSON

The following is the complete field order (types shown descriptively, not literal values):

```
manifest_version: integer 1
generator_id: fixed ASCII string
table_hash: fixed lowercase 64-hex string
dna:
  dna_version, seed, rarity, talent_budget,
  attributes: power, speed, chin, stamina, skill,
  prime_weeks, decline_weeks
name: first, last, display
physical: height_in, reach_in, stance, weight_lb, weight_class
style: enum
portrait:
  portrait_version, skin, hair_style, hair_color, facial_hair,
  head_shape, mouth, brow, background, scar, shoulder_jitter
```

All object keys occur exactly once, in that order. Objects and strings use standard JSON delimiters. There is no whitespace or terminal newline, no omitted field, no escaped ASCII, and no non-ASCII content. Integers use minimal base-10 spelling (only shoulder_jitter may be negative; zero is `0`, never `-0`). No float, exponent, bool, null or array is valid in a manifest. All derived field values must equal regeneration for its embedded seed. This rejects an internally plausible but non-derived name, attribute, style or portrait.

The strict parser accepts at most **8192 bytes**, nesting depth at most **8**, ASCII/valid UTF8 only, and exactly one object. It rejects noncanonical serialization, unknown/missing/duplicate/escaped-alias/case-alias fields, trailing data, reordered fields, wrong types and invalid versions. It must enforce byte/depth limits before allocating an unbounded structure, reject duplicates while decoding, then compare the complete typed canonical output with regeneration. JSON numeric values must never pass through float64. In contrast, the separate seed convenience parser may normalize uppercase input.

The manifest digest is a separate function, never a self-referential field:

```
SHA256(ASCII "SLUG fighter manifest digest" || 00 || ASCII "v1" || 00 || canonical manifest bytes)
```

Its lowercase 64-hex output fingerprints a preview. It is not a fighter ID, ownership proof, consensus hash or signed admission.

## Independent corpus and acceptance

Before emitting expectations, the oracle must regenerate and verify the copied existing DNA v1 corpus. It must read only the frozen independent DNA reference and reviewed tables, never production Go generator output. Validate weight sums/boundaries, round-even ties, stream encodings/rejections/exhaustion, every style predicate and precedence independently of sampled seeds.

Include fixed zero/all-ones/00..1f/public chain seeds, the observed legacy short-ID collision pair, then the lowest positive integer seeds needed to cover each rarity, weight class, style and portrait option. Integers become 32-byte big-endian seed bytes, not decimal seed text. Store exact canonical manifest bytes, digest and field values; keep generation-selection rules reproducible. Include literal SHA256 preimages/digests at counters 0/1/256 and counter-boundary checks, scripted rejection/exhaustion vectors, direct physical/style boundary vectors and strict-codec negative vectors. The oracle's `--check` must regenerate the complete committed corpus and compare it, not merely validate its internal checksums.

Report a fixed deterministic sample mix over public integer seeds, including the new pressure predicate. Distribution diagnostics are tuning evidence, not new rarity probabilities or approval of fighter/price balance. All cases are public previews, including seeds that do not meet any prospect target.

## Admission and rollout boundary

This slice contains no fighter ID, gym, birth, account, transfer, roster, fight, price, mining-capacity or ownership field. A future read-only admitted projection may reference the complete existing `prospect_id` together with the authenticated unchanged receipt and birth; abbreviated IDs are display-only. It cannot invent a new identity from a seed or claim that a plain JSON receipt is trusted without verification.

Current job/context formats bind DNA version but not the complete manifest generator/table selector. Before official generator assignment, introduce an explicit version-bound issuance contract or an immutable mapping from a committed version, preserving older encodings/IDs. No retroactive assignment of official names/traits/portraits to historical records is authorized by this candidate. D68 birth remains job issuance, and D69 admission remains separate. A manifest preview neither renews an expired job nor changes a retained birth.
